facts.fact: The World Bank's June 2020 diagnostic lists PROBMIS as an integrated public financial and budget management system run by the Ministry of Finance with all ministries connected; it gives the date as the report's published date, 2020-06.
The World Bank's June 2020 diagnostic lists ANTILOPE as the payroll management system for public servants (salaries and pensions); it gives no other date than the report's published date, 2020-06.
